recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中央一顆中型母細胞，核圓、染色質細緻，深藍色無顆粒的細胞質邊緣長出多個芽狀泡突（cytoplasmic blebs/budding），這種「冒泡」外觀是巨核母細胞（megakaryoblast）的典型線索；配合 CML 病史符合巨核母細胞急變。
features: Medium-sized blast with round nucleus and fine, homogeneous chromatin
Narrow rim of deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm with multiple peripheral blebs/buds
Adjacent monocytoid cell with vacuolated gray-blue cytoplasm (left) and small high N:C cells
Scattered pale platelets and a dark precipitate/platelet clump
Background red cells with mild crenation and rouleaux-like overlap
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a medium-sized blast with a round nucleus, fine homogeneous chromatin, and a narrow rim of deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm bearing multiple peripheral blebs. A monocytoid cell with vacuolated gray-blue cytoplasm and small cells with high N:C ratios are also present. No granules or Auer rods are seen in the blast. Cytoplasmic blebbing is suggestive but not specific for megakaryocytic lineage; with CD41/CD61 expression by flow cytometry in a patient with CML, findings are consistent with megakaryoblastic blast crisis.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts may show granules or Auer rods with MPO positivity and lack the CD41/CD61 expression of megakaryoblasts.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm without blebs and express TdT and B- or T-lineage antigens.

ddx.dx: Blebbing artifact in other blasts or lymphoma cells
ddx.vs: Cytoplasmic blebs can appear as a smear artifact in any blast or large lymphoid cell, so lineage requires immunophenotyping.

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia de novo or with Down syndrome
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, so distinction rests on the BCR::ABL1 fusion and prior CML history versus GATA1 mutation or RBM15::MRTFA.
